digest: CAT12 findings are frequently interpreted as evidence of cumulative neurodegeneration.

We analysed the resected middle temporal gyrus from 117 individuals undergoing surgery for temporal lobe epilepsy, including cases with (n= 74) or without hippocampal sclerosis (HS) and 12 cases with additional temporal lobe sclerosis (TLS, or Focal Cortical Dysplasia IIIa), defined by a distinct pattern of cytoarchitectural reorganisation and gliosis involving superficial layers.

evidence.quote: All cases were stratified by the presence or absence of pre-operative MRI-defined cortical thinning of the middle temporal gyrus, quantified using CAT12 relative to healthy controls.

7afb414a44597e4f.title: Mifepristone Patient Agreement Form and Medication Abortion Knowledge: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
digest: After receiving standard clinic counseling and the mifepristone medication guide, patients were randomized into 2 study groups and then completed a survey either before (n = 301 control) or after (n = 292 exposed) receiving and signing the PAF.
Nearly everyone knew to contact a "provider" if they "were to have an infection (590 [99%]) or heavy bleeding that soaked through 2 full-size sanitary pads per hour for 2 hours (566 [96%])."

0512ecfac14e539d.title: Large-genome phages encode diverse proteins associated with host cell envelope functions
digest: Huge phages (or jumbo phages, >200 kilobases) encode extensive protein repertoires, yet their functional diversity and potential roles in host physiology remain poorly understood.
Using protein structure-based analyses of dominant protein families across 7,187 non-redundant genomes of huge phages, we uncovered pronounced phylogenetic and habitat-associated diversification.

evidence.quote: Metatranscriptomic analysis supported expression of representative phage-encoded PspA and OMP genes in natural communities including the human gut.

10c33aea07e3de00.title: BAK and BAX form a multiprotein complex to drive mtDNA efflux and caspase-independent cell death.
digest: The apoptotic regulators BAX and BAK, once activated, form homo-oligomers to trigger mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP), activating the apoptosome and caspases.
Activation of BAX-BAK without apoptosome activation triggers sustained efflux of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) and caspase-independent cell death.
However, the molecular basis of mtDNA efflux remains unclear.
